items.title: Nyanga Bantaba & Saller Sports Threaten Legal Action Over Fake Scorpions Jerseys
items.summary: By Nelson Manneh Nyanga Bantaba and Saller Sports, the official merchandisers and kit manufacturers of The Gambia’s national football teams, have threatened legal action against individuals and businesses producing or selling counterfeit Scorpions jerseys. The warning comes ah...
